style.vernacular: Dense mid-rise concrete-frame apartment blocks of 4 to 12 storeys faced in cream or white travertine and stone veneer, with older brick and plastered Qajar and Pahlavi houses and arcaded bazaar courtyards in the south. Roofs are flat and plant-covered; domes and iwans in turquoise tile mark mosques and imamzadeh shrines. Plane trees and pines line the streets, with the Alborz range behind the north of the city.
style.ornament: Persian arches and iwans with turquoise and blue glazed tile mosaic, banna'i patterned brickwork, muqarnas and carved stucco, mirror-work (ayeneh-kari) in grand halls, fluted domes on drums, and travertine-clad modern facades with arched balconies.

sources.what: Iranian architecture: brick, adobe, stucco, turquoise tile on domes, banna'i brick patterns, iwans and courtyards; rapid demolition and rebuilding in Tehran
